newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AWB undecided on likely Pakistan wheat tender.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AWB undecided on likely Pakistan wheat tender.

text.p: Australia had not decided if it would bid in a likely Pakistan tender for 90,000 to 100,000 tonnes of wheat, Joan McGovern, spokeswoman for the Australian Wheat Board (AWB), said.
McGovern was responding to a Chicago report that Pakistan was expected to tender on March 16 for U.S. or Australian wheat.
The AWB believed the Pakistan government also had not decided if it would put the order out to tender, she said.
If it did tender, the AWB was not sure if it would bid because it had so much business in the pipeline, she said.
